title: 游戏中的扩展：面向多样化虚拟世界中具身智能体的持续预训练
summary: 研究在Minecraft等多样化虚拟世界中对具身智能体进行持续预训练，覆盖0.8B至27B模型、50至1600小时数据和五种数据混合共120种配置。发现数据量提升域内表现，多样性促进向相关世界迁移，模型规模提升数据效率但单世界训练下远域泛化更差，并拟合出经验扩展律。
summary_en: A controlled study of continued pre-training for embodied agents across diverse virtual worlds, spanning 0.8B-27B models, 50-1,600 hours of data, and five data mixtures (120 configs). More data improves in-corpus performance, diversity aids transfer to related worlds, and larger models improve data efficiency but generalize worse to distant worlds under single-world training; an empirical scaling law is fitted.
